name: Home Assistant Statistics
description: Publishes aggregate rename statistics through Home Assistant MQTT Discovery. Requires the Home Assistant MQTT integration with discovery enabled.

settings.label: Home Assistant URL
settings.description: The local URL of your Home Assistant instance.

settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.description: Create a long-lived access token in your Home Assistant profile. It is encrypted by the operating system and is never exposed to the extension.

capabilities.reason: Publish aggregate counters and recent/top media names as registered MQTT sensor entities grouped beneath one Media Renamer device. Requires Home Assistant's MQTT integration and MQTT discovery. File paths and credentials are never included.
